title: The Extermination Fire Lotus
summary: The Little Fairy Doctor uses her Woeful Poison Body to hold off the Old Ground Demon Ghost while Xiao Yan fuses his flames, with Yao Lao's Bone Chilling Flame and the Life Transforming Flame, into the Extermination Fire Lotus. The lotus hits the Old Ground Demon Ghost, then slips out of Xiao Yan's control and threatens to wipe out the Inner Academy. Xiao Yan flies toward it to hold it back until two old men tear open space and throw it away. First Elder Su Qian introduces them as Elder Qian and Elder Bai, retired guardians of Jia Nan Academy, who praise Xiao Yan for holding several Heavenly Flames and warn that the Woeful Poison Body brings a hard fate. The Old Ground Demon Ghost turns out to be alive and tries to flee with his Spatial Blood Escape, but Bai Lie kills him, and Qian Mu says the two of them are Nine-Star Dou Zongs, not Dou Zuns. Xiao Yan takes the corpse and asks the elders to look at the Demon Poison Spot in his body, which they say only a Dou Zun could remove.
events: The Little Fairy Doctor holds the Old Ground Demon Ghost off at great cost to herself.
Xiao Yan forms the Extermination Fire Lotus and strikes the Old Ground Demon Ghost.
The lotus slips out of Xiao Yan's control and he flies toward it to stop it.
Elder Qian and Elder Bai tear through space and expel the lotus.
Su Qian introduces the two guardians; they praise Xiao Yan and remark on the Woeful Poison Body.
The Old Ground Demon Ghost tries the Spatial Blood Escape and is killed by Bai Lie.
Qian Mu says he and Bai Lie are Nine-Star Dou Zongs, one star short of Dou Zun.
Xiao Yan takes the corpse and the elders examine his Demon Poison Spot.
cultivation: The Old Ground Demon Ghost is a Seven-Star Dou Zong. Qian Mu and Bai Lie are at most Nine-Star Dou Zongs. The elders recall Xiao Yan as a Da Dou Shi when they last saw him.
